name: Jagadhari–Bilaspur National Highway
significance: NH 907G is a branch of NH 907. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Jagadhari to Bilaspur, and it meets NH 907 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 907 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Paonta Sahib to Pansara
